findings.title: Infrastructure toolchain is pinned only to lower bounds
evidence: infra/lab/terraform/versions.tf:6-7 proxmox provider version ">= 0.66.0" (no lock file tracked)
findings.impact: Lab rebuilds are not reproducible and can silently pick up regressions or malicious versions within the allowed range.
findings.recommendation: Commit `.terraform.lock.hcl` and pin Ansible collections to exact versions committed alongside requirements.

findings.title: gitleaks allowlist can mask real 40-hex OSQUERY keys and a token-shaped string
findings.impact: A genuine OSQUERY_KEY or placeholder-shaped token in a future diff would be suppressed globally, not just for the archived evidence line.
findings.recommendation: Scope allowlists to the exact file/line of the archived evidence rather than a global regex/literal.

report: Reviewed `.github/dependabot.yml`, workflow action pinning, `.gitleaks.toml`, and the lab dependency pins. GitHub Actions are SHA-pinned and the org scan downloads tools by version with sha256 verification.
